exact_remaining_representation_gap.source_fact: Phase 1 base/max HP is 52000; first lethal is prevented and Magnolia returns immediately in phase 2 with 60000 HP.
exact_remaining_representation_gap.problem: Current ProjectV2 Encounter can heal to full, transform with full/percent/absolute-preserving health, and set phase, but has no action that raises a live role's maximum health above the Creature definition. Healing 60000 into a 52000-max Creature cannot represent the published phase-2 state.
exact_remaining_representation_gap.required_disposition: Encounter owner/architect should add the smallest encounter-local health-capability needed for an exact current/max health override, or provide another accepted existing representation. Do not mint a fake second Magnolia Creature identity solely to obtain 60000 max HP.
